title: Optimization Techniques for Solving the Minimum Red--Blue Separating Set Problem with an Application to Human--AI Text Separation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41081v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the so-called Minimum Red''Blue Separating Set Problem (MRBSSP) which arises from computational geometry. In particular, we propose a compact Set-Cover ILP formulation, safe preprocessing rules, a Greedy Randomized Adaptive Search Procedure (GRASP), and two exact approaches: one is based on Logic-Based Benders Decomposition (LBBD) approach, and the second represents a novel Branch-and-Benders-Cut (BBC) approach. These two exact approaches are compared to ILP--alongside GRASP and the Variable Neighborhood Search (VNS) from literature. Experiments on 250 random graphs with up to 500 vertices reveal complementary strengths: ILP yields the best feasible solutions, LBBD provides the strongest lower bounds and smallest mean optimality gap, and BBC certifies optimality most frequently. tldr: 该论文针对最小红-蓝分离集问题提出了包括集合覆盖ILP模型、GRASP启发式、基于逻辑的Benders分解（LBBD）和新颖的分支-Benders-割（BBC）在内的多种优化技术，各方法展现出互补优势，并将其成功应用于通过词汇图特征区分人类与AI生成的文本。
